rules.statement: A notary's statement in a deed regarding the passing of consideration is insufficient to establish valuable consideration without additional evidence, especially when the surrounding circumstances suggest otherwise.
rules.supporting_quote: "Relying on a recent judgment of this Court in Diyes Singho v. Herath[ 1 (1962) 64 N. L. R. 492.] learned counsel contended that the notary's statement in the attestation of those deeds regarding the passing of consideration is by itself insufficient to prove that 3D1 and 3D2 were for valuable consideration."
